auditor_note: No schema-level validation prevents start > end. Result is not a bypass/return-everything bug: because the tool's documented overlap semantics are 'window_end >= start AND window_start <= end', an inverted range narrows the match to only windows that SPAN both endpoints (22 large multi-year windows matched, e.g. 2024-02-05..2034-01-30), which is internally consistent with the stated semantics, just non-intuitive for a caller who mistyped the range. No crash, no leak, no wrong data — soft/low-severity UX gap only (no warning that the range is inverted), not counted as a TIER1-3 finding.
